rationale: Opening tie l13 reduces l12 overload from 118 to 110 MW, then shedding 15 MW at bus 3 further reduces l12 to 96 MW (within 100 MW limit). Total load shed is 15 MW, which is minimal compared to alternatives. Single actions alone cannot resolve the overload, and other combinations either fail to resolve overloads or require more shedding (25 MW).
